rules.statement: Use the standardized name "개인정보 처리방침" at the top of the document and distinguish it from other notices.
Put the processor's name in the title so the data subject can identify who is responsible.
Preamble states why the policy is established and published, with the processor's name as the grammatical subject.
Name the services the policy covers when the company name alone does not make this clear; for many services list all names or a lead name plus a linked detail page.
Order the document as title, preamble, body; show a table of contents with in-page links at the start of the body.
Separate each statutory item explicitly and write in plain, specific terms; explain legal or technical terms.

goodPatterns: Preamble: processor complies with PIPA and related laws, and publishes the policy under PIPA Art. 30 to explain procedures and handle complaints quickly.
Foreign operators subject to PIPA write the policy in Korean.

commonDefects.defect: Non-standard title (e.g. 개인정보 보호정책, 개인정보 취급방침).
Preamble omits which services the policy applies to when several brands exist.
No table of contents or links for a long policy.

publicationNotes: Online: post continuously; reachable without login from the first web/app screen; app: within 3 steps recommended (L487-495). Offline alternatives per Decree 31(3) (L515-528). Rendering is out of scope for the drafter but feeds the operator checklist.
